jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner
jobs.description:
At bunq, we're not just building a banking app; we're reshaping how people around the world experience financial freedom. As a (Senior) Product Owner at bunq, you are the driving force behind a core piece of our user's experience. Your mission is to own your product, understand our users (Eva) inside and out, and ship beautiful, effective features that make their lives easy.

We have several exciting and immediate openings within our Product sector. Submit your application, and our team will work with you to understand your unique skillset and interests, helping you find the perfect current opportunity that suits your career aspirations.

Take ownership

As a (Senior) Product Owner, you will own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for your domain, whatever that may be. You get it done.

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for your domain, relentlessly focused on solving user problems and creating massive value.

  • Lead the full product lifecycle, from identifying user needs and defining problems to collaborating with world-class engineers and designers to ship elegant and effective solutions.

  • Relentlessly use data, A/B testing, and user feedback to measure the impact of your work, ensuring every feature we ship moves us closer to our North Star.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Credit
jobs.description:
At bunq, we're not just building a banking app; we're reshaping how people around the world experience financial freedom. As a Product Lead - Credit, you’ll be instrumental in empowering our users with the flexible credit they need to support their lifestyle. You'll spearhead the entire credit domain, from ideation to international launch, building innovative solutions that are simple, transparent, and instantly accessible.

Take Ownership

As Product Lead - Credit, you’ll play a critical role in building a product that truly supports our users' lifestyles. You'll be the driving force behind the mission: "Give me a credit line to support my lifestyle."

  • Own the entire product lifecycle for our credit offerings, from designing and implementing the product and its underlying infrastructure to continuous maintenance and improvement.

  • Drive the strategic launch and expansion of our credit products into our current and new markets, navigating the unique complexities of each region.

  • Obsess over the user journey, collaborating with design and engineering teams to craft a world-class, seamless, and bug-free credit experience.

  • Work hand-in-hand with legal, risk, and compliance teams to ensure our credit products are not only innovative but also fully compliant with all regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
jobs.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.
Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.
Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.
As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

jobs.title: Product Owner (Solutions Collaboratives & Applications Métier)
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de la DSI d’Exotec, vous êtes responsable d’un portefeuille de solutions collaboratives et d’applications métier utilisées par plus de 1 000 collaborateurs en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.

Vous pilotez leur évolution de bout en bout, de l’analyse des besoins métiers à la conception fonctionnelle, jusqu’au déploiement et à l’adoption. Vous intervenez notamment sur l’écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot…) et Koddex, notre plateforme de gestion des connaissances et des processus internes.

À l’interface entre les métiers et les équipes techniques, vous traduisez les besoins en solutions concrètes, en vous appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des plateformes, de leurs possibilités et de leurs contraintes. Vous êtes garant de la valeur délivrée, de la qualité des solutions et de leur adoption durable.

Vos missions

  • Définir la stratégie produit : construire la roadmap, prioriser les évolutions et piloter la valeur du portefeuille en fonction des besoins métiers et des résultats attendus.
  • Concevoir les solutions fonctionnelles : analyser et challenger les besoins, modéliser les processus, workflows et règles de gestion, puis formaliser les exigences et critères d’acceptation.
  • Piloter les évolutions de bout en bout : travailler avec les équipes techniques et les partenaires, valider la faisabilité, organiser les recettes et sécuriser les mises en production.
  • Développer l’adoption : accompagner les changements d’usage, mesurer l’utilisation et la satisfaction, et piloter l’amélioration continue à partir des retours utilisateurs.
  • Garantir la gouvernance du portefeuille : assurer la cohérence des solutions, maîtriser les risques et les dépendances, et piloter les relations avec les éditeurs et partenaires.


Votre profil

  • Vous avez une expérience confirmée en Product Ownership ou en pilotage de solutions applicatives, idéalement sur une plateforme utilisée par plus de 1 000 utilisateurs.
  • Vous avez déjà piloté concrètement des évolutions, de l’expression du besoin à la conception fonctionnelle, au déploiement et à l’adoption.
  • Vous comprenez le fonctionnement des plateformes SaaS ou low-code et savez modéliser des processus et des solutions fonctionnelles en lien avec les équipes techniques.
  • Vous connaissez l’écosystème Microsoft 365, notamment Teams, SharePoint et Power Platform. Une expérience de Koddex ou d’une plateforme comparable constitue un atout.
  • Vous maîtrisez les pratiques Agile et savez arbitrer les priorités en conciliant valeur métier, faisabilité technique, risques et expérience utilisateur.
  • Vous êtes autonome, pragmatique, doté d’un bon relationnel et d’un anglais professionnel.

Ce qui fera la différence

Votre capacité à présenter des réalisations concrètes dont vous avez personnellement assuré la conception fonctionnelle, les arbitrages et le déploiement à grande échelle. Au-delà de la gestion de backlog, nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les plateformes, d’en exploiter les possibilités et de transformer les besoins métiers en solutions opérationnelles.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

Position Summary

As a Senior Product Designer at PF, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the design and user experience of our B2B products. You will drive the design process from discovery to delivery, taking ownership of projects and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

As a senior member of the design team, you will work alongside other designers, contribute to design strategy, and ensure that our products align with both customer needs and business goals. This role offers you the chance to lead complex design projects, work on strategic initiatives, and be a key player in achieving PF’s mission to become the most trusted partner in real estate across the MENA region.

Key responsibilities

  • Design Leadership: Lead the end-to-end design process for one or more B2B products—from discovery and ideation through prototyping, user testing, and delivery. Set a high bar for craft, quality, and execution across the team.

  • User-Centred Design: Champion user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, creating intuitive, effective experiences that balance customer value with business goals.

  • UI & Visual Design: Demonstrate exceptional UI and visual design skills, with a strong eye for detail, interaction design, motion, micro-interactions, and creating moments of delight.

  • Rapid Execution: Produce high-quality design work in fast-paced environments while maintaining strong design thinking, process, and attention to detail.

  • Problem Solving: Translate user research, data, and business objectives into thoughtful product solutions. Continuously iterate to improve usability, engagement, and outcomes.

  • Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, researchers, engineers, and fellow designers to define problems, align on solutions, and deliver exceptional product experiences.

  • Design Strategy: Help shape the design strategy for the B2B product suite, ensuring a consistent experience across web and mobile. Collaborate with other design teams to evolve a unified product vision and design language.

  • Testing & Iteration: Validate concepts through prototyping, user testing, and experimentation, using feedback and data to refine designs and improve product outcomes.

  • Content Creation: Experience creating product videos, motion graphics, or other visual content is a plus.

Desired Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Design, UX, or a related discipline, with a proven track record of shipping high-quality digital products in fast-paced environments.

  • Design Craft: Expertise across product discovery, UX, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and design systems.

  • Strong ability to use research and data to inform decisions.

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect user needs with business objectives and contribute to product and design strategy.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams and presenting design rationale with confidence.

  • Mentorship: Passion for supporting and developing other designers through coaching, feedback, and leading by example.

  • Ownership & Execution: Self-driven and accountable, with the ability to lead complex initiatives from concept through launch while maintaining a high standard of quality.

  • Attention to Detail: A strong eye for visual polish, usability, accessibility, and the small details that create exceptional user experiences.

  • AI Proficiency: Fluency with AI tools across the design process, from research synthesis to rapid prototyping. Critical evaluation of AI output and knowledge when generative capabilities genuinely improve an experience versus when they don't.

Our promise to talent

At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.

Property Finder Guiding Principles

  1. Think Future First

  2. Data Beats Opinions, Speed Beats Perfection

  3. Optimise for Impact

  4. Act Like An Owner

  5. The Biggest Risk is Taking no Risk at All

Facebook

Glassdoor

jobs.title: Product Designer, AI-Native Products (Staff-Level / L6)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.






THE ROLE: 

We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to lead design for some of Synthesia's AI-native, agentic Sessions product surfaces.

Sessions are the experiences where employees learn through conversation, companies lrun a survey at scale, and AI becomes a direct participant in how work gets done - not just a tool behind the scenes.

This area is central to redefining what a video platform can be: moving upstream from content creation into workforce development, and making complex AI capabilities feel natural, trustworthy, and effective for everyday users.

You'll operate as a senior IC: setting direction, influencing roadmap decisions, shaping bets with Product and Engineering leaders, and raising the craft bar.

In practice, this role is about solving AI-native design problems, for example:

 - Designing real-time, conversational avatar experiences that feel engaging and natural - not robotic or gimmicky - for employees learning and practising skills at work.

 - Creating interaction patterns for AI-driven workflows that give users the right amount of control, transparency, and trust without overwhelming them with complexity.

 - Improving output quality through better structure, guidance, and feedback loops - helping users understand what the AI is doing, catch issues early, and iterate with confidence.

 - Working at the frontier where AI changes what "interaction" means, and the best patterns are genuinely still being invented.
   
   


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Own major AI-native bets end-to-end, from problem framing to shipped outcomes and iteration.

 - Set a design vision for our "Sessions" surface, and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent.

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering to define what "great" looks like (principles, quality bar, success metrics) and then drive toward it.

 - Prototype and test interaction models quickly - including novel agentic and conversational patterns - and know when high-fidelity matters.

 - Raise the bar on craft: interaction design, UI quality, systems thinking, and consistency across AI-native experiences.
   
   


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU BRING:

 - Significant experience designing complex, high-usage product surfaces - ideally including AI-native products, agentic features, conversational interfaces, or products where the system takes meaningful autonomous action.

 - Strong craft in interaction design and visual design, and a track record of shipping work that measurably improves the product experience.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity: you can turn unclear and fast-moving problem spaces into crisp direction, and you do not wait for perfect clarity.

 - Systems thinking: you understand how AI capabilities, model constraints, and product architecture shape what's actually possible in the UX - not just what looks good on a screen.

 - Excellent communication in design reviews and cross-functional decision-making contexts.

 - Experience designing workflows where trust, transparency, and user control are central - helping users feel confident in AI-driven outputs rather than confused or excluded.

 - A track record of tackling novel problems in maturing product spaces, and shaping the product from early-stage bets through to execution.

 - The ability to leverage feedback from users and customers to ensure the product continues to meet real needs - including enterprise users with high stakes around quality, compliance, and scale.
   
   


AT SYNTHESIA WE EXPECT EVERYONE TO:

 - Put the Customer First

 - Own it & Go Direct

 - Be Fast & Experimental

 - Make the Journey Fun

You can read more about this in this public Notion page: https://synthesia.notion.site/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2





BENEFITS

 - A flexible, remote friendly role based out of Europe or one of our hubs in London, Copenhagen, Munich, or Zurich. 

 -  25 days of annual leave + public holidays in the country where you are based.

 - A generous referral scheme.

 -  Work from home set up.

 - At Synthesia, you can work from anywhere (within reason) in the world for up to 60 days per year!

 - A huge opportunity for career growth as you’ll help shape a market-defining product.

jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. THE ROLE:

Synthesia is used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. The largest deployments now run thousands of creators across dozens of markets, languages, and compliance regimes. What decides whether those accounts expand or stall is not another avatar - it's whether admins, legal teams, and programme owners can actually stay in control.

We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to own that layer end-to-end: workspace setup and governance, the content lifecycle, and the analytics and integrations that close the loop. This is the work that turns a proof of concept into a seven-figure renewal, and right now it is wide open.

You'll operate as a senior IC: setting direction, influencing roadmap decisions (not just contributing), shaping bets with Product and Engineering leaders, and raising the bar on how we think about enterprise design problems.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Set a design vision for our Enterprise surface and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent. As things scale across SSO, compliance, analytics, and billing, you're keeping the mental model consistent.

 - Systems thinking: not just about interaction flows, but about enterprise systems. You understand how identity systems, compliance regimes, and scale constraints shape what's actually possible in the UX. You think in mental models and multi-step workflows, not single screens.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity: you can turn unclear and fast-moving problem spaces into crisp direction, and you do not wait for perfect clarity.

 - Experience designing workflows where trust, transparency, and user control are central - helping users feel confident in AI-driven outputs rather than confused or excluded.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
About Youtrust

Founded in 2013, Youtrust is a European digital trust platform. It enables document, identity and business analysis and verification, compliance checks, and electronic signature.
Compliant with the strictest European regulations, including the eIDAS regulation, and ISO/IEC 27001 certified, Youtrust guarantees the security, integrity and traceability of digital transactions, while giving businesses full control over their data.
With more than 35,000 customers and 1 million users across Europe, Youtrust brings together the entire digital trust chain in a flexible, easily integrable API, enabling AI Agents, SaaS software and SMEs/mid-sized companies to secure their regulatory processes.
As a B Corp certified company, Youtrust is committed to combining technological innovation, compliance with European standards and positive impact, putting security and transparency at the service of businesses.

Your Role

As an intermediate designer, you’ll be supported by Elodie, Senior Product Designer and your manager, and by the senior designers on the team as you grow into full autonomy.

Designing simple, intuitive interfaces within a squad

You’ll work daily with your squad’s Product Manager, alongside developers and Product Marketing, moving between discovery and delivery to reach the squad’s OKR objective. You’ll conduct user research, lead co-design workshops, and turn insights into pragmatic solutions that fit our design vision, the existing product, and operational constraints. Following our recent rebrand, this also means helping bring our new identity into the product for a consistent end-to-end experience. You’ll produce journeys, wireframes, and prototypes, using AI to explore and prototype faster, test them with users, and support developers through to release. After launch, you’ll support PMMs and Marketing on rollout and help track KPIs to measure impact.

Contributing to the design team

You’ll help improve our methods and product quality, contribute to the Design System, and share your expertise and industry insights with the team.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery with your PM: frame problems against the squad's goals, choose the right methods, run user research and co-design workshops.

  • Design user journeys, wireframes and interactive prototypes that fit our design vision, our new brand and technical constraints.

  • Test your solutions with users before development.

  • Hand designs off to developers and follow them through to release.

  • Support launches with Product Marketing, then track KPIs and share the results.

  • Use AI to speed up your work while checking what it produces, and help design AI features that handle errors and let users correct them.

  • Help improve our Design System and its accessibility, and help structure how the design team works (Figma files, documentation, handoff).

  • Take part in Design Critics and Knowledge Sharing.

  • Share what you learn, including your AI workflows, and suggest better ways of working.

Your Profile

  • You have 2 to 5 years of experience as a Product Designer, ideally on a SaaS product. Experience on an API product is a plus. Startup or large company, both are welcome.

  • You master Figma: components, auto layout, variables, interactive prototypes.

  • You have run user interviews and usability tests yourself, and you turn what you learn into design decisions.

  • You have used a design system and contributed components to one.

  • You know the basics of accessibility (WCAG) and want to go further.

  • You are interested in Design Ops: how a design team organises its files, documentation and tools.

  • You explain your design choices clearly, with user insights and data to back them.

  • You are curious about AI, you have tried it in your work, and you want to learn more. You also know when not to trust its output.

  • You ask for feedback and act on it. You take ownership of your projects and know when to ask for help.

  • You pay attention to details: edge cases, states, consistency, accessibility.

  • You speak fluent French (C2) and English at C1 level at least.

  • We will ask for your portfolio before the interviews.

Recruitment Process

  1. Call with Guillhem (Talent Acquisition Manager) - 30 min

  2. Interview with Déborah Lévy-Bencheton (Head of Design) - 45 to 60 min

  3. Case study with Elodie (Senior Product Designer), and Déborah - 1 hour

  4. Final conversation with Laure (Product & Design Director) - 30 min

Why join Youtrust now?

  • A mission that matters in a world challenged by AI-driven fraud

  • A vision built on integrity

  • A European & sovereign platform

  • A certified B Corp

  • The golden age of Youtrust

Benefits

France Benefits

  • Salary: €48,000 to €57,000 base salary, plus up to €2,000 variable

  • BSPCE

  • Meal vouchers (Swile): €10.50/day, 50% covered by Youtrust

  • Health insurance (Alan): 50% covered by Youtrust

  • Life & disability insurance: 100% employer-covered

  • Wellbeing: Axomove (4 physio sessions) and Moka.care (6 therapy/coaching sessions)

  • Transportation: 50% reimbursement for public transport for hybrid workers

  • Leeto or Wellpass (ex-Gymlib)

  • Time off: 10 RTT days/year, plus menstrual leave, parenthood benefits, seniority days

  • 1 volunteering day/year, learning & development budget, and more.

Location: Paris (Office-based). Contract: Permanent (CDI).

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (B2C)
Senior Product Owner (m/f/d)
Product Designer | NordVPN Apps | Senior
jobs.description:
THE WORLD’S MOST ADVANCED VPN, AND A WHOLE LOT MORE.

If you’re a curious problem-solver who carves their own path, join the team behind Threat Protection Pro, the NordLynx protocol, and the fastest VPN on the planet—tools that put privacy, security, and control back in people’s hands.

Your impact? Helping millions take back control of their online security, privacy, and data.

The Design Team is a dynamic, multidisciplinary group of Product designers, Web designers, UX researchers, UX writers, and Graphic designers. We're building the future of digital freedom across our cybersecurity suite products, such as NordVPN, NordPass, Saily & Coveron. We are helping millions of users own their online lives. We aim to simplify the complex world of cybersecurity for everyone. We thrive on honest feedback to help each other grow and believe in the freedom to take initiative, be bold, and run with new ideas.

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our NordVPN Apps Design team. This position is about owning the design for your squad, running your projects end to end, and increasingly questioning the brief, not just delivering on it.

 


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the whole flow. Design experiences that feel native on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and browser extensions while staying recognizably Nord. Explore multiple directions, you’ll think through problems from the ground up, instead of copying what's been done before and always know the why behind your choices.

 - Push the problem, not just the pixels. You'll surface assumptions early with your PO and engineers, challenge briefs when the evidence points elsewhere, and sometimes make the call that the best design is removing a flow entirely.

 - Craft with the system. Apply our design system without losing intent and help it grow. When you spot a gap, you propose the component, not the workaround.

 - Ship, don't just design. Back your decisions with evidence while partnering with UX Research or running validation yourself. Stay close to engineers through the build and own Design QA so what ships is what you intended.

 


CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience: 3+ years in product design (mobile & desktop apps), with work that shows fluency across platforms and growing ownership of complex problems.

 - Smart prototyping: You pick the right tool for the question. Quick mockups for flow logic, high-fidelity prototypes when the interaction needs to feel real, AI when you need breadth fast. Prototype with real data.

 - Ownership and communication: You handle disagreement constructively, bring engineering realities in before they become blockers, and earn the kind of trust that gets you invited in early.

 - Attention to detail: You have a meticulous eye for visual and interaction details while crafting high-quality, user-friendly experiences.
   
    


 ADDITIONAL

 - Experience designing accessible and inclusive interfaces for people with disabilities is a strong plus. Understanding how to apply WCAG conformance criteria in design is highly valued.

 - Experience in motion design.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Sharpen your edge: training, mentorship, and room to grow — always.
   
   

 - Take the time you need: extra vacation days, sick days, and time off when life calls.
   
   

 - Get premium healthcare: private health insurance in Lithuania and Poland — fully covered.
   
   

 - Protect your peace: enjoy free subscriptions to Calm, Headspace, and Mindletic, and our own resilience and mindfulness trainings.
   
   

 - Own your fitness: in-house gyms, sport cards, online workouts, and personal guidance — on us.

If you’re a curious problem-solver who carves their own path, join the team behind Threat Protection Pro, the NordLynx protocol, and the fastest VPN on the planet—tools that put privacy, security, and control back in people’s hands.

Your impact? Helping millions take back control of their online security, privacy, and data.

The Design Team is a dynamic, multidisciplinary group of Product designers, UX/UI designers, UX researchers, UX writers, and Graphic designers. We're building the future of digital freedom across our cybersecurity suite products, such as NordVPN, NordPass, Saily & Coveron. We are helping millions of users own their online lives. We aim to simplify the complex world of cybersecurity for everyone. We thrive on honest feedback to help each other grow and believe in the freedom to take initiative, be bold, and run with new ideas.



We're looking for a Product Designer to own the experience where users control their relationship with our products — the User Control Panel (UCP) and account management platform.




MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Driver Experience and Fulfilment
Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 - Profitable since 2017

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

 - Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)



So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



We're looking for an experienced and proactive Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team at Zable (Lendable). You'll join a team of 5 product designers and report to the VP of Product & Design.



You'll work mainly on the Zable app, our financial SuperApp with 2M+ monthly active users. It brings together credit cards, loans, memberships, mobile and more in one place. You'll own complex product areas end-to-end, from discovery and research through to polished, production-ready design. You'll set design direction alongside PMs and Engineering, mentor other designers, and help raise the bar for craft and outcomes across the team.




THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

 - 5+ years of product design experience, ideally in fintech or a fast-paced startup

 - Strong mobile app and web experience

 - Customer-obsessed and data-literate: you challenge solution-led briefs and back decisions with evidence

 - Takes real creative risks, and can bring a team along with a clear story for why a bolder direction is right

 - Confident with senior stakeholders, and pushes back when quality or customer outcomes are at risk

 - AI-native: you push past the first obvious output, not just work faster

 - Enjoys raising the bar for other designers through mentoring and feedback

 - Bonus:
   
   - Designing AI-powered products (explainability, human override)
   
   - Shipping improvements without engineering, e.g. via CMS or no-code tools
   
   - Regulated environments, e.g. Consumer Duty
   
   - UX writing
     
     


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Lead discovery, choosing the right research method and turning findings into clear design direction

 - Own design delivery for your squad, from first flows through to build

 - Work with engineers throughout design, not just at handoff, weighing build cost in your decisions

 - Contribute to the design system, and know when breaking from it is right for the customer

 - Run usability tests and experiments with clear measures of success

 - Use AI across your workflow, including pushing design changes to production yourself

 - Design to Consumer Duty and accessibility standards, and call out issues in others' work

 - Run design critiques and write rationale that stands on its own




OUR DESIGN PRINCIPLES

 1. Simplicity wins
    
    1. If a user has to think too hard, we’ve already lost. We strip away complexity, jargon, and unnecessary steps to make managing finances effortless. Every screen should feel intuitive, focused, and frictionless.

 2. Evidence over ego
    
    1. We don’t design based on opinions. Everything we build is informed by data, tested, and refined based on real user behavior.

 3. Trust is our best feature
    
    1. Finance is built on trust. Every design decision should reinforce transparency, security, and user confidence. We prove we care by helping users make financial decisions that empower them.
       
       

Interview Process

 - CV screening

 - An introductory call with someone from the Talent Team and/or hiring manager

 - A take-home exercise to complete in your own time

 - Task debrief with members of the design team (45 mins)

 - Final round in person at the office (3x30 min, same day):
   
   - VP Product & Design
   
   - Engineering team members
   
   - Final round interview with our CPO




LIFE AT LENDABLE

 - Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

 - Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

 - Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

 - Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

 - Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

 - Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

 - Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

 - Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog https://blog.lendable.co.uk/!

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer - 6 Month FTC
jobs.description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.



Introducing Design at Trainline 👋
At Trainline, we’re focused on making rail the most convenient, compelling and sustainable way to travel. Design plays a central role in how we deliver on that ambition, bringing together customer insight, creativity and technology to build experiences that people trust, value and return to. Our UX team, led by Will Barker (UX Director, formerly IDEO and Samsung), is committed to building the world’s #1 rail platform, and we believe great design helps businesses grow, adapt with confidence and keep delivering value as they scale.
Within our Pricing & Value team, we want to transform how our product helps customers find the best value for their train travel, and celebrate the savings we help them make along the way. This role will help shape how customers feel when they use Trainline, strengthening our position in the UK market while driving innovation across a number of exciting pricing and value experiences. You’ll partner with fellow Product Designers in the Value space as part of a larger Product and Design community, sharing ideas, craft and learning as you go.


In this role as the Lead Product Designer, Pricing & Value, you will... 🚄

 - Help define how customers should feel when using our product, so they are confident they are getting the best value for their journey

 - Lead design across a set of pricing and value initiatives, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on, high-quality execution

 - Shape experiences that celebrate the savings we help customers make, strengthening our position in the UK market

 - Work closely with Product, Engineering and Data partners to explore, validate and deliver experiences on both Android and iOS apps, ensuring information is timely, interactions are intuitive, and customer needs are at the centre of every decision

 - From early discovery through to experimentation and delivery, use insight, craft and data to continuously improve outcomes, playing a key role in shaping how customers experience Trainline when it matters most

 - Collaborate with other Product Designers in the Value space and the wider Product and Design community, helping keep experiences coherent and raising the quality bar together

 - Share clear, compelling stories that bring colleagues together around complex problems and help shape priorities

 - Explore how AI-enabled tools and workflows can improve the speed and effectiveness of how we design



We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

 - Significant experience leading Product Design or UX within complex, consumer-facing digital products

 - Experience designing journey-based, real-time or service-oriented experiences, particularly where clarity and trust are critical

 - Strong hands-on design skills, including high proficiency in Figma and a genuine passion for craft and quality

 - A history of using research, insight and data-informed experimentation to improve outcomes

 - Confidence designing across channels, ideally with a focus on mobile apps and strong interaction and information design skills

 - Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to align partners around complex problems

 - A proactive mindset and a collaborative approach with Product, Engineering and Operational teams

 - Ideally, a curiosity about AI-enabled tools and workflows, and how they can improve the speed and effectiveness of design



More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

 - 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

 - ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

 - 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

 - ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/trainline/, Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeattrainline/ and Glassdoor https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Overview/Working-at-Trainline-EI_IE249203.11,20.htm!

Description

MapTiler is moving toward becoming an AI-accelerated company, and design is a part of that change. We are looking for a Head of Design to lead the craft and the design practice across our products and customer experience, and help to define the new setup and processes for how designers should work. This is a completely new role at MapTiler!

What you will do

  • Lead the design team of 5 and make the people decisions that come with it: hiring, performance, wellbeing, career progression and education of designers.
  • Work closely with product managers, developers and marketing, and represent design in discussions with the executive team.
  • Measurably increase the user-centric mindset and UX maturity of the company: define how we measure it, report it to leadership and act on what you find.
  • Lead design's transition to an AI-accelerated way of working and help to decide how designers use AI in their daily practice, in line with the company's overall direction.
  • Own design craft, quality standards, and the coherence of the experience across all MapTiler products and services.
  • Own the design roadmap, which runs in parallel to the product and marketing roadmaps.
  • Make company-wide design decisions, set standards and quality, and speak up when they are not met.

What we expect from you

  • At least 8 years of experience in UX, UI, or product design, including 3+ years in a design leadership role.
  • Experience building and leading a design team, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Strong design craft, shown by a portfolio or a case study of projects you led, and the ability to set and defend quality standards.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in design work, and a well-argued view of where they help and where they do not.
  • Ability to align with or lead Developer Experience (DX), ensuring B2B / B2D products work effectively for both human users and AI agents.
  • The ability to explain design decisions with concrete arguments based on qualitative and quantitative user research.
  • The ability to influence and negotiate at the executive level.
  • An understanding that good design serves a deeper purpose than looking good.
  • A strong drive for self-improvement, learning, sharing knowledge, and trying new approaches.

Nice to have

  • Interest in maps or cartography.
  • Knowledge of the GIS or map industry.
  • Experience with Agile methodology.

What we offer

  • Widescreen LCD, a laptop of your choice, and all the resources you need for your work. 
  • Flexible working hours to help you easily balance your personal and professional life.
  • Work remotely from anywhere in Czechia, or hang out with us at our hub in Brno.
  • Collaborate with the best from major global brands.
  • Grow your career with dedicated support for continuous learning, attending conferences, and building your personal brand.
  • A friendly, connected team and regular team-building events across Europe.

About MapTiler

We make maps easy so that everyone can understand the world better. Our platform powers everything from global weather forecasting and humanitarian crisis management to flight trackers and the Swiss railways. Our maps are viewed by hundreds of millions of people worldwide every month.
We are deeply rooted in the developer and open-source communities. Since our users and customers are primarily developers, engineers, and geo-experts, we don't only do traditional account management, we also build technical partnerships.

Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

About Carrot

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family-building platform providing care for everyone, everywhere. Trusted by more than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems, Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for employers and award-winning experiences for millions of people worldwide. From maternity through menopause and pre-pregnancy through parenting, Carrot is dedicated to expanding access and improving outcomes. Carrot empowers members with compassionate, personalized, and inclusive support.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape the end-to-end experience for members. You'll own design from concept through execution for our mobile app priorities. You'll report to our Director of Product and be the design lead for this team, with the opportunity to pair with product designers working on other parts of the Carrot experience.

The work spans two levels. You'll go deep on individual mobile-first experiences, including Sprints, our program for members working on their metabolic health alongside fertility, pregnancy, and menopause care. You'll also design how distinct pieces of the member experience fit together into one seamless mobile experience.

 

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own mobile design end to end — concept through high-fidelity execution on iOS and Android.
  • Bring the pieces together — design the information architecture and navigation that make distinct parts of the member experience feel like one product.
  • Design for return, not just first use — drive adoption and retention through experiences that earn a member's attention daily, weekly, and monthly.
  • Make complexity feel simple — turn large, dynamic, nuanced information into something members trust at a glance.
  • Partner closely with our Content Designer so visual and written communication land as one experience.
  • Ground decisions in evidence — run qualitative and quantitative research, and use it to back what we build.
  • Grow our design system with accessibility, consistency, and scalability in mind.

 

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Shipped design work that measurably moved member adoption and engagement, with metrics you can point to.
  • Conducted user research and testing and developed a sharp sense of updates to best drive member engagement and business goals.
  • Contributed to our design system- letting teams ship faster and more consistently.

 

About You

You likely have:

  • A Bachelor's Degree
  • 10+ years in product/UX design, with a portfolio of mobile-first work and end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-step journeys 
  • Experience building and working on consumer apps focused on daily and weekly active usage
  • A track record designing for engagement and retention — habit formation, behavior change, wellness, or similar
  • AI as a core part of your design practice, plus experience designing AI-powered product experiences
  • Systems thinking to create experiences that feel clean and simple for users
  • Strong visual and interaction craft, hands-on prototyping, and fluency with building products people love to use
  • Experience leading user research or usability testing

 

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience with behavior change frameworks or gamification
  • Experience helping teammates develop as designers
  • Empathy and sensitivity to the challenges of healthcare journeys

 

Why This Role Matters

Fertility, pregnancy, and menopause care unfold over years, not appointments. Much of what shapes a member's outcome happens between clinical visits. Nobody returns to an app out of obligation — they return because it's useful, respects their time, and doesn't make them feel judged. Design is the difference.

Engagement here isn't a vanity metric; it's how the product does anything at all for a member's health. You will shape that experience, with the opportunity to put your work in front of millions of people.

 

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30 minutes
  3. Portfolio Interview — 1 hour
  4. Final Round Interviews — 2 hours

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

 

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $145,000-$170,000.  Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. 

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.
